full_prompt_en: The image is a square, high-contrast red, black, and white graphic portrait of two musicians standing close against a solid scarlet background. The left figure is a young man with thick irregular dark curls, a pale face, and a serious direct gaze. He wears a nearly black top. A wide red guitar strap crosses diagonally from his right shoulder toward the lower left, and the red body of an electric guitar is partly visible at the lower edge. The right figure is a young woman with long dark hair, a pale face, and a similarly direct, slightly lifted gaze. Her black-and-white striped shirt occupies a broad area on the right, the horizontal bands contrasting with the diagonal strap beside it. Both bodies are cropped at the lower waist, so the heads and torsos fill the frame. The woman stands slightly behind or beside the man, their shoulders overlapping near the center. Scarlet red occupies all the open background and reappears in the strap, instrument, and rough print marks across the clothing. Faces are reduced to bold white fields and deep black features, with only a few intermediate patches. The black hair, shirt, and outlines merge into large connected masses; small broken ink flecks roughen their edges. The light is graphic rather than naturalistic: the white faces and bands appear abruptly bright against the dense black, without a visible cast shadow or modeled room. The picture has a frontal, confrontational rhythm made from two vertical figures, one strong diagonal, and repeated horizontal stripes. Its overall effect is raw and poster-like, with limited color and distressed ink texture giving the still pose force.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、红黑白强反差的图形肖像：两名音乐人紧挨着立在纯猩红背景前。左侧年轻男子有浓密而不规则的深色卷发、浅脸和严肃的直视目光。他穿近黑色上衣。一条宽红色吉他背带从右肩斜跨向左下，电吉他的红色琴身在下画边部分可见。右侧年轻女子留长深发、浅色脸，目光同样直视且略微抬起。她的黑白条纹上衣占据右侧较宽区域，横带与身旁的斜背带形成对比。两人的身体在腰部以下被裁掉，头和躯干因此填满画幅。女子略站在男子身后或身侧，肩膀在中央附近重叠。猩红占满所有空背景，也回到背带、乐器和衣服上的粗糙印痕中。面孔被归约为醒目的白色区域与深黑五官，只留少量中间色块。黑头发、衣服和轮廓连成大片相接的暗块；细小破墨点让边缘粗粝。光是图形化而非写实的：白脸与白横带突然从密黑中亮起，没有可见投影或成形的室内明暗。画面以两条竖向人物、一条强斜线和重复横条形成正面而直接的节奏。整体效果粗砺且像海报，有限色彩与磨损墨纹给静止姿态带来力量。
style_prompt_en: A distressed screenprint-like graphic surface relies on three dominant values: solid scarlet, deep black, and abrupt white. Large connected dark masses sit against a flat bright field, while pale openings and repeated narrow bands cut through them. Contours are bold but imperfect, with broken ink, speckles, and scraped interruptions around the edges. A strong diagonal crosses a mainly vertical arrangement, and horizontal repetition adds a second rhythm. Tonal modeling is greatly reduced; contrast itself supplies the light. The crop is close, frontal, and forceful, with saturated color occupying nearly every open area. The surface retains a raw poster texture instead of a smooth digital finish.
style_prompt_zh: 带磨损的丝网印刷式图形表面依靠三种主导明度：纯猩红、深黑和突然跳出的白色。大片相连暗块落在平涂亮色场上，浅色开口和重复窄条将其切开。轮廓粗而不齐，边缘带断墨、斑点与刮擦般空缺。一条强斜线穿过以竖向为主的布局，横向重复带来第二重节奏。明暗塑形被大幅压缩，对比本身就是光。裁幅贴近、正面而有力，饱和颜色占据几乎所有开放区域。表面保留粗粝海报纹理，而非平顺的数字收尾。
theme_en: Two musicians against a solid red graphic background
theme_zh: 两名音乐人立在纯红色图形背景前
name: The White Stripes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
